skills.name: Common Denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator to combine or compare fractions that have different denominators.

skills.name: Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of two mixed numbers or of a whole number and a mixed number.

skills.name: Borrowing/Regrouping
skills.definition: Regroup one whole unit into a fraction when the fractional part of the subtrahend is larger than that of the minuend.

skills.name: Improper Fraction Conversion
skills.definition: Convert an improper fraction (numerator ≥ denominator) within a mixed number into a proper whole-number-plus-fraction form.
